messages:
anya: quick postmortem for the eviction-simplify rollout — we rolled it back at 09:10 UTC. short summary below.
kevin: ugh, what happened?
anya: a race where demote + async eviction could leave a prefix tagged as "hot" but with a stale residency token. reads go to the wrong node and got 5xxs for ~2m.
maria: was this the tombstone propagation gap we discussed?
anya: yup. our optimistic demote path didn't publish tombstones reliably across the shard mesh. the handoff assumed eventual visibility which isn't true under the fast-replicate path.
tle: can we mitigate without reintroducing full leases? maybe a cheap version bump per-prefix on demote so stale tokens fail-fast?
kevin: version bump seems fine, but do we have a safe rollback if that also regresses latency?
anya: plan we landed on: revert the simplification (done), add a short fix — publish a small "demote-marker" that forces local tombstone materialization, + a short-lived version increment on demote so mismatched token checks trigger local fallback.
maria: sounds reasonable. small followups: 1) telemetry to count token mismatches 2) alert on >0.1% mismatch rate 3) test harness for simultaneous demote+read race.
tle: agree. followup long-term: revisit the simplification but with a two-phase demote: (a) mark-only + wait-for-ack, (b) final demote. that buys correctness without full lease semantics.
infra-bot: deploy rollback completed by @deploy-bot in staging at 09:12 UTC — deploy id: rwd-stg-evict-042.
kevin: nice. who owns the short fix?
anya: i'll do the demote-marker + token bump PR, aim EOD. maria will own telemetry/alerting. tle will prototype two-phase demote design doc next week.
kevin: thx. please add a minimal unit/integration test that simulates concurrent demote+read and asserts no 5xxs.
anya: adding tests now. quick snippet of the demote marker idea: 
```
// on demote:
prefix.version += 1
publish("demote-marker", prefix.id, prefix.version)
// readers check version and fall back to read-through if mismatch
```
kevin: nice and simple. :thumbsup:
anya: will post PR + CI link when ready.
